"},"advanced_truck.png":{"dataUrl":"data:image/png;base64,","isBinary":true,"mimeType":"image/png","content":""},"casino.js":{"dataUrl":"data:application/javascript;base64,","isBinary":false,"mimeType":"application/javascript","content":"export class CasinoManager {
    constructor(game) {
        this.game = game;
        this.currentCasino = null;
    }

    open(casinoName) {
        this.currentCasino = casinoName;
        this.showCasinoUI();
    }

    showCasinoUI() {
        const casinoModal = document.getElementById('casino-modal');
        if (!casinoModal) {
            this.createCasinoModal();
        } else {
            casinoModal.classList.remove('hidden');
        }
        
        const title = document.getElementById('casino-title');
        if (title) title.textContent = this.currentCasino;
    }

    createCasinoModal() {
        const modal = document.createElement('div');
        modal.id = 'casino-modal';
        modal.className = 'glass-modal casino-modal';
        modal.innerHTML = `
            <div class="modal-content">
                <div class="modal-header">
                    <h3 id="casino-title">${this.currentCasino}</h3>
                    <button class="close-modal" id="close-casino">×</button>
                </div>
                <div class="modal-body">
                    <div class="casino-stats">
                        <span>Your Balance: <span id="casino-balance">$${this.game.state.money.toLocaleString()}</span></span>
                    </div>
                    
                    <div class="casino-games">
                        <div class="game-card" id="double-nothing">
                            <h4>Double or Nothing</h4>
                            <p>50/50 Chance to double your bet!</p>
                            <div class="bet-inputs">
                                <button class="bet-preset" data-amount="100">$100</button>
                                <button class="bet-preset" data-amount="1000">$1k</button>
                                <button class="bet-preset" data-amount="10000">$10k</button>
                            </div>
                            <button class="play-btn" id="play-double">Gamble!</button>
                        </div>

                        <div class="game-card" id="slot-machine">
                            <h4>Ultra Slots</h4>
                            <p>Match 3 icons for a 10x payout!</p>
                            <div class="slots-container">
                                <div class="slot" id="slot1">🍒</div>
                                <div class="slot" id="slot2">🍋</div>
                                <div class="slot" id="slot3">💎</div>
                            </div>
                            <button class="play-btn" id="spin-slots">Spin ($500)</button>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>
        `;

        document.body.appendChild(modal);

        // Event Listeners
        modal.querySelector('#close-casino').onclick = () => modal.classList.add('hidden');
        
        modal.querySelector('#play-double').onclick = () => this.playDoubleOrNothing();
        modal.querySelector('#spin-slots').onclick = () => this.spinSlots();
        
        modal.querySelectorAll('.bet-preset').forEach(btn => {
            btn.onclick = () => {
                modal.querySelectorAll('.bet-preset').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('selected'));
                btn.classList.add('selected');
                this.selectedBet = parseInt(btn.dataset.amount);
            };
        });
        
        this.selectedBet = 100;
        modal.querySelector('.bet-preset[data-amount="100"]').classList.add('selected');
    }

    playDoubleOrNothing() {
        const bet = this.selectedBet;
        if (this.game.state.money < bet) {
            this.game.ui.notifications.showToast("Insufficient funds!", "error");
            return;
        }

        this.game.state.money -= bet;
        this.game.ui.updateMoneyUI(this.game.state.money);
        
        const win = Math.random() > 0.5;
        if (win) {
            const reward = bet * 2;
            this.game.state.money += reward;
            this.game.ui.notifications.showToast(`YOU WON $${reward.toLocaleString()}!`, "success");
            this.game.ui.notifications.showFloatingText(`+$${reward.toLocaleString()}`, 'money');
        } else {
            this.game.ui.notifications.showToast(`You lost $${bet.toLocaleString()}. Better luck next time!`, "error");
        }
        
        this.updateBalanceUI();
        this.game.state.save();
    }

    spinSlots() {
        const cost = 500;
        if (this.game.state.money < cost) {
            this.game.ui.notifications.showToast("Insufficient funds!", "error");
            return;
        }

        this.game.state.money -= cost;
        this.updateBalanceUI();
        
        const icons = ['🍒', '🍋', '💎', '🔔', '7️⃣'];
        const s1 = icons[Math.floor(Math.random() * icons.length)];
        const s2 = icons[Math.floor(Math.random() * icons.length)];
        const s3 = icons[Math.floor(Math.random() * icons.length)];

        document.getElementById('slot1').textContent = s1;
        document.getElementById('slot2').textContent = s2;
        document.getElementById('slot3').textContent = s3;

        if (s1 === s2 && s2 === s3) {
            const reward = cost * 10;
            this.game.state.money += reward;
            this.game.ui.notifications.showToast(`JACKPOT! $${reward.toLocaleString()}!`, "success");
            this.game.ui.notifications.showFloatingText(`+$${reward.toLocaleString()}`, 'money');
        } else if (s1 === s2 || s2 === s3 || s1 === s3) {
            const reward = cost * 2;
            this.game.state.money += reward;
            this.game.ui.notifications.showToast(`Small Match! $${reward.toLocaleString()}`, "success");
        }

        this.updateBalanceUI();
        this.game.state.save();
    }

    updateBalanceUI() {
        const balance = document.getElementById('casino-balance');
        if (balance) balance.textContent = `$${this.game.state.money.toLocaleString()}`;
        this.game.ui.updateMoneyUI(this.game.state.money);
    }
}
"},"chat-manager.js":{"dataUrl":"data:application/javascript;base64,","isBinary":false,"mimeType":"application/javascript","content":"export class ChatManager {
    constructor(game) {
        this.game = game;
        this.container = document.getElementById('chat-messages');
        this.input = document.getElementById('chat-input');
        
        this.npcNames = [
            "TruckKing99", "SpeedyGonsales", "RoadRunner", "DieselDan", 
            "LadyTrucker", "GearHead", "HaulStar", "BigRig_Pro", 
            "CargoMaster", "RoadPirate", "NightOwl", "HighwayHero"
        ];
        
        this.phrases = [
            "Just delivered a massive cargo to NYC!",
            "Anyone seen the police lately?",
            "The new CyberTruck is insanely fast.",
            "Macau casino just took all my money :(",
            "Nice truck, @player!",
            "Heading to the workshop for some upgrades.",
            "The weather in Tokyo is great today.",
            "Just hit level 10! Let's goooo!",
            "Who wants to race to Las Vegas?",
            "Watch out for the speed cameras near Paris.",
            "That nitro boost is a lifesaver.",
            "Is the harbor mission worth it?",
            "Just earned $50k in one haul!",
            "The physics in this game feel great.",
            "Found a secret shortcut through the desert."
        ];

        this.init();
    }

    init() {
        if (!this.input) return;

        // Close button
        const closeBtn = document.getElementById('close-chat');
        if (closeBtn) {
            closeBtn.onclick = () => this.toggle(false);
        }

        // Toggle button in settings
        const toggleBtn = document.getElementById('toggle-chat-btn');
        if (toggleBtn) {
            toggleBtn.onclick = () => this.toggle();
        }

        this.input.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
            if (e.key === 'Enter') {
                this.sendMessage();
            }
        });

        document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
            if (e.key === 'Enter' && document.activeElement !== this.input) {
                // Only focus if visible
                if (!document.getElementById('chat-container').classList.contains('hidden')) {
                    this.input.focus();
                }
            }
        });

        // Start random NPC chatter
        this.startNPCChatter();
        
        // Welcome message
        setTimeout(() => {
            this.addMessage("System", "Welcome to Global Trucker Online!", "system");
        }, 1000);
    }

    toggle(force) {
        const chat = document.getElementById('chat-container');
        if (typeof force === 'boolean') {
            chat.classList.toggle('hidden', !force);
        } else {
            chat.classList.toggle('hidden');
        }
    }

    sendMessage() {
        const text = this.input.value.trim();
        if (text) {
            this.addMessage("You", text, "user");
            this.input.value = '';
            
            // Small chance for NPCs to react to player
            if (Math.random() > 0.7) {
                setTimeout(() => this.simulateNPCReply(), 1500);
            }
        }
    }

    addMessage(user, text, type = "npc") {
        if (!this.container) return;

        const msgDiv = document.createElement('div');
        msgDiv.className = 'chat-msg';
        
        const userSpan = document.createElement('span');
        userSpan.className = `chat-${type}`;
        userSpan.textContent = user + ": ";
        
        const textSpan = document.createElement('span');
        textSpan.textContent = text;
        
        msgDiv.appendChild(userSpan);
        msgDiv.appendChild(textSpan);
        
        this.container.appendChild(msgDiv);
        this.container.scrollTop = this.container.scrollHeight;

        // Auto-remove old messages to keep it clean
        if (this.container.children.length > 50) {
            this.container.removeChild(this.container.firstChild);
        }
    }

    startNPCChatter() {
        const delay = 5000 + Math.random() * 15000;
        setTimeout(() => {
            const name = this.npcNames[Math.floor(Math.random() * this.npcNames.length)];
            const phrase = this.phrases[Math.floor(Math.random() * this.phrases.length)];
            this.addMessage(name, phrase, "npc");
            this.startNPCChatter();
        }, delay);
    }

    simulateNPCReply() {
        const reactions = [
            "Lol nice", "I agree!", "Same here.", "Wait, really?", 
            "Cool!", "Haha", "GG", "Interesting..."
        ];
        const name = this.npcNames[Math.floor(Math.random() * this.npcNames.length)];
        const text = reactions[Math.floor(Math.random() * reactions.length)];
        this.addMessage(name, text, "npc");
    }
}

import { TruckController } from 'data:application/javascript;base64,';
import { MissionGenerator } from 'data:application/javascript;base64,';
import { ACHIEVEMENTS } from 'data:application/javascript;base64,';
import { GameState } from 'data:application/javascript;base64,';
import { UIManager } from 'data:application/javascript;base64,';
import { VEHICLE_CATALOG, COMPANY_FOUNDING_COST } from 'data:application/javascript;base64,';
import { calculateDistance } from 'data:application/javascript;base64,';
import { RadioManager } from 'data:application/javascript;base64,';
import { PoliceChaser } from 'data:application/javascript;base64,';
import { NPCManager } from 'data:application/javascript;base64,';
import { CasinoManager } from 'data:application/javascript;base64,';
import { ChatManager } from 'data:application/javascript;base64,';

class GlobalTruckerGame {
    constructor() {
        this.state = new GameState(this); // Pass game instance to state for callbacks
        this.ui = new UIManager(this);
        
        this.map = null;
        this.truck = null;
        this.missionGenerator = null;
        this.currentMission = null;
        this.radioManager = null;
        this.casinoManager = new CasinoManager(this);
        this.chatManager = new ChatManager(this);

        this.initializeGame();
        this.ui.init(); // Initialize UI after game components are set up
        this.handleAchievementChecks(); // Check achievements on startup based on loaded state
        this.initDayNightCycle();
        this.setupNitro();
    }
    
    setupNitro() {
        this.nitroActive = false;
        this.nitroBtn = document.getElementById('nitro-btn');
        this.mapContainer = document.getElementById('map');
        
        // UI button listeners
        if (this.nitroBtn) {
            this.nitroBtn.addEventListener('mousedown', () => this.activateNitro());
            this.nitroBtn.addEventListener('mouseup', () => this.deactivateNitro());
            this.nitroBtn.addEventListener('mouseleave', () => this.deactivateNitro());
            
            // Touch support
            this.nitroBtn.addEventListener('touchstart', (e) => { e.preventDefault(); this.activateNitro(); });
            this.nitroBtn.addEventListener('touchend', (e) => { e.preventDefault(); this.deactivateNitro(); });
        }

        // Shift key listener
        document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
            if (e.key === 'Shift') this.activateNitro();
        });
        document.addEventListener('keyup', (e) => {
            if (e.key === 'Shift') this.deactivateNitro();
        });
    }

    activateNitro() {
        this.nitroActive = true;
        if (this.nitroBtn) this.nitroBtn.classList.add('active');
        if (this.mapContainer) this.mapContainer.classList.add('map-shake');
        if (this.truck && this.truck.vehicleMarker && this.truck.vehicleMarker.getElement()) {
            this.truck.vehicleMarker.getElement().classList.add('nitro-active');
        }
    }

    deactivateNitro() {
        this.nitroActive = false;
        if (this.nitroBtn) this.nitroBtn.classList.remove('active');
        if (this.mapContainer) this.mapContainer.classList.remove('map-shake');
        if (this.truck && this.truck.vehicleMarker && this.truck.vehicleMarker.getElement()) {
            this.truck.vehicleMarker.getElement().classList.remove('nitro-active');
        }
    }
    
    initDayNightCycle() {
        this.gameTimeMinutes = 720; // Start at 12:00 PM
        this.timeDisplay = document.getElementById('time-display');
        this.mapContainer = document.getElementById('map');
        
        setInterval(() => {
            this.gameTimeMinutes += 1; // 1 in-game min per real second
            if (this.gameTimeMinutes >= 1440) this.gameTimeMinutes = 0;
            
            const hours = Math.floor(this.gameTimeMinutes / 60);
            const minutes = this.gameTimeMinutes % 60;
            const ampm = hours >= 12 ? 'PM' : 'AM';
            const displayHours = hours % 12 || 12;
            const displayMinutes = minutes < 10 ? '0' + minutes : minutes;
            
            // Determine day/night
            const isNight = hours >= 19 || hours < 6; // Night 7PM to 6AM
            const icon = isNight ? '🌙' : '☀️';
            
            if (this.timeDisplay) {
                this.timeDisplay.textContent = `${icon} ${displayHours}:${displayMinutes} ${ampm}`;
            }
            
            if (this.mapContainer) {
                if (isNight) {
                    this.mapContainer.classList.add('map-night-filter');
                    this.mapContainer.classList.remove('map-day-filter');
                } else {
                    this.mapContainer.classList.add('map-day-filter');
                    this.mapContainer.classList.remove('map-night-filter');
                }
            }
        }, 300); // Fast cycle: 300ms per in-game minute
    }

    // --- Game Initialization & Setup ---
    initializeGame() {
        try {
            // Force cleanup of any existing map
            const mapContainer = document.getElementById('map');
            if (mapContainer && mapContainer._leaflet_map) {
                mapContainer._leaflet_map.remove();
                mapContainer._leaflet_map = null;
            }

            // Initialize map
            this.map = initMap();
            
            // Add workshops and casinos to the map
            this.workshops = addWorkshops(this.map);
            this.casinos = addCasinos(this.map);
            
            this.missionGenerator = new MissionGenerator(this.map);
            
            // Create truck or plane based on selected vehicle
            // Destroy previous truck controller if it exists
            if (this.truck) {
                this.truck.destroy();
                this.truck = null;
            }
            this.truck = new TruckController(this.map, this, this.state.selectedVehicle);

            // Ensure joystick state is applied to the new truck controller
            this.toggleJoystick(this.ui.joystickEnabled);

            // Initialize radio manager
            if (this.radioManager) {
                this.radioManager.destroy();
            }
            this.radioManager = new RadioManager(this);
            
            this.currentMission = null; // Clear previous mission data
            this.generateNewMission(); // Generate the first mission

            // Fake Multiplayer
            this.npcs = new NPCManager(this);
            this.npcs.init();

        } catch (error) {
            console.error("Game initialization failed:", error);
            this.ui.notifications.showModal("Error", "Failed to start the game. Please refresh the page.");
        }
    }

    // --- Mission Logic ---
    generateNewMission() {
        const vehicleCategory = this.getVehicleCategory(this.state.selectedVehicle);
        this.currentMission = this.missionGenerator.createMission(vehicleCategory);
        
        if (this.truck) {
            this.truck.setPosition(this.currentMission.startCoords);
        }

        // Create route between start and destination
        createRoute(this.map, 
            this.currentMission.startCoords, 
            this.currentMission.destinationCoords
        );

        this.ui.updateMissionUI(this.currentMission);

        this.activeHazards = [];

        // Spawn police if it's a smuggler mission
        if (this.currentMission.cargo.isSmuggler) {
            this.ui.notifications.showModal("High Risk Contract!", "You are hauling contraband. Keep an eye out for authorities... they are tracking you!", [{text: "I'm ready", className: "btn-danger"}]);
            
            // Spawn a police chaser roughly off-center from the start position
            setTimeout(() => {
                const spawnLat = this.currentMission.startCoords[0] + (Math.random() > 0.5 ? 2 : -2);
                const spawnLng = this.currentMission.startCoords[1] + (Math.random() > 0.5 ? 2 : -2);

export class PoliceChaser {
    constructor(gameInstance, spawnCoords) {
        this.game = gameInstance;
        this.map = gameInstance.map;
        this.speed = 0.0025; // Base speed per tick (slightly faster than basic truck)
        
        // Create Marker
        const policeIcon = L.divIcon({
            className: 'police-icon',
            html: `
                <div style="font-size: 24px; filter: drop-shadow(0 0 5px red); animation: blink 0.5s infinite;">
                    🚓
                </div>
            `,
            iconSize: [30, 30],
            iconAnchor: [15, 15]
        });

        this.marker = L.marker(spawnCoords, { icon: policeIcon }).addTo(this.map);
        this.isActive = true;

        this.chaseInterval = setInterval(() => this.chase(), 100);
    }

    chase() {
        if (!this.isActive || !this.game.truck || !this.game.truck.vehicleMarker) return;

        const playerPos = this.game.truck.vehicleMarker.getLatLng();
        const myPos = this.marker.getLatLng();

        const latDiff = playerPos.lat - myPos.lat;
        const lngDiff = playerPos.lng - myPos.lng;
        
        // Simple normalization
        const dist = Math.sqrt(latDiff * latDiff + lngDiff * lngDiff);
        
        if (dist < 0.01) { // Reduced catch radius for fairer gameplay
            // Collision!
            this.game.busted();
            this.destroy();
            return;
        }

        const moveLat = (latDiff / dist) * this.speed;
        const moveLng = (lngDiff / dist) * this.speed;

        this.marker.setLatLng({
            lat: myPos.lat + moveLat,
            lng: myPos.lng + moveLng
        });
    }

    destroy() {
        this.isActive = false;
        clearInterval(this.chaseInterval);
        if (this.map && this.marker) {
            this.map.removeLayer(this.marker);
        }
    }
}
